hits.about: Bab Al Qasr Apartments by Burtville Developments, a unique blend of luxury and comfort, offers a range of serviced accommodations in the heart of Abu Dhabi. This modern residential building stands out with its variety of units, including Deluxe Studios, Studios, 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and 2-bedroom penthouses. Each apartment is a testament to our commitment to comfort and style, featuring modern bathrooms, a living area, a kitchenette equipped with a combination microwave, hob, kettle, and fridge, a dining area, HD flat-screen TV with international channels, a work desk, an in-unit safe, built-in air conditioning, and free wireless internet access. Daily housekeeping services and on-site communal laundry facilities ensure a convenient stay for residents.The on-site amenities at Bab Al Qasr Apartments enhance the living experience with a fitness Centre, sauna and steam room, swimming pool, jacuzzi, communal gardens, business Centre, meeting room, café, restaurant, and bar. Built in 2016, this 5-star hotel perfectly blends contemporary design and traditional Arabian hospitality. Its prime location, just 40 minutes from the airport and 2 km from the city Centre makes it an ideal choice for both leisure and business travelers.
